card.name: Frequency and/or severity of effects
card.fires_on: The word "or" or "and/or" right after "frequency" or "incidence", where "severity" comes next. It also fires on "at" before a loudness figure.

modes.label: Frequency or severity
modes.description: A linking "or" or "and/or" after frequency or incidence in drug-interaction text, just before "severity".
modes.example: which could increase the frequency<< or>> severity of adverse reactions.

modes.label: Loudness level
modes.description: The word "at" before a very loud sound level in a joke-like passage.

card.writes: It promotes words for intensity, magnitude and strength, so the model predicts "severity" or "intensity" next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word between "frequency" and "severity" when the text says an effect may become more frequent or more severe.
